# Proxy Sentry CSV v1.8.18

- Added Target URL lists from TXT files with selectable current URL.
- Added an optional URL List `No auto-next` mode so Apply target URL can keep the current link selected.
- URLs without a scheme, such as `tickets.bso.org`, are now normalized to HTTPS before opening, applying, or checking.
- Added bulk browser selection for selected proxy rows.
- Fixed the Search field layout when URL List mode is enabled.
